q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F2.FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F1.FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F1 JOIN FOLLOW F2 ON F1.FOLLOWEE = F2.FOLLOWER GROUP BY F2.FOLLOWER ORDER BY F2.FOLLOWER

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 counts the number of followers for each user who is being followed by at least one user, while Q2 counts the number of distinct followers for each user who is being followed by at least one user.
counterexample_dsp: Consider a scenario where user A follows user B, and user C follows user B. Q1 will count user B as having 2 followers (A and C), while Q2 will count user B as having 1 distinct follower (A or C, as the count is distinct).
